description_en: Adds multiple accelerated domain names to Content Delivery Network (CDN). You can add up to 50 accelerated domain names in a single call
description_zh: 调用BatchAddCdnDomain可以实现批量添加加速域名，一次最多可以添加50个加速域名
name: BatchAddCdnDomain

parameters.help_en:
The business type of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

web: Images and small files.

download: Large file downloads.

video: On-demand video and audio streaming
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名的业务类型。取值：

web：图片小文件。

download：大文件下载。

video：视音频点播
parameters.name: cdn_type

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names that you want to add to CDN. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要接入CDN的加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. If you do not specify this parameter, the ID of the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，不传时，自动补全默认资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of origin fetch addresses
parameters.name: sources

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

domestic: The Chinese mainland.

overseas: Global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

global: Global
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域。取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。

overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。

global：全球
parameters.name: scope
